null_definition: 8 train-only within-site joint-age-sex derangements; query remains current positive condition; L4 null independently permutes its positive anchor conditions

scientific_gate.near_zero_rule: all four late checkpoints satisfy relative graph L1 < 1e-4 AND centered score maximum < 1e-3; report measured gradients, score changes and float32 precision, not initialization alone
scientific_gate.gradient_rule: native-to-relation gradient and weighted-local-to-projection gradient measured separately; persistent absent respective paths at all four late checkpoints in >=2 anchors is No-Go
scientific_gate.no_development_value: L3 has no positive train JS(null)-JS(true) gap at any late checkpoint in any anchor AND its selected validation CE is not lower than L1,L2,L4 in each of all five anchors
scientific_gate.validation_comparison: each method checkpoint minimizes original val CE + original graph regularizer during exactly first 80 epochs
scientific_gate.formal_development_reuse: none; if Go, all formal tasks restart from historical training-start anchors; development is never reported as formal

storage_gate.df_note: ossfs reports virtual 16EiB and zero inodes, not a physical disk capacity measurement
